args.summary: One device (FX-DISK-01, hostname fx-macbook-air-disk) is trending toward running out of disk space, with 7.6% free (20 GB of 256 GB) and a persistent low-disk pattern across 10 of the last 14 daily snapshots. The trend shows free space decreasing by about 0.8 percentage points per day.

claims.text: Device FX-DISK-01 (fx-macbook-air-disk) has 7.6% free disk space (20 GB free of 256 GB total) on its system volume as of 2026-06-12.
Low disk has been observed in 10 of the last 14 daily snapshots, meeting the persistent low-disk definition (low disk in ≥70% of snapshots with at least 7 snapshots).
The linear trend estimates free space is decreasing by 0.80 percentage points per day.
The low_disk threshold is defined as system volume having less than 15% free space on the latest snapshot.
The low_disk_persistent threshold is defined as low disk in at least 70% of snapshots (minimum 7 snapshots).
One other device had too few snapshots (less than 7) for a trend assessment; its latest snapshot was checked but no trend could be computed.

caveats: Telemetry covers 2026-05-20 to 2026-06-12 only; no data outside this window.
One device had insufficient history for trend analysis; its current state was checked but not included in the low_storage insight.
